lead_raw_text:
The structure of NdDy6Co2 crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with a 24-atom unit cell (Nd2Dy12Co4) distributed over 7 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Co centers with 12 geometric neighbors (2 Co, 6 Dy, 4 Nd), Dy centers with 12 or 14 neighbors, and Nd centers with 20 neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis shows corner, edge, and face sharing among Co and Dy polyhedra, including corner- and edge-sharing between Dy 14-vertex and Co 12-vertex polyhedra.
